findings.quoted_text: Contractor shall also perform any additional services Client reasonably requests during the Term at no additional charge.

Contractor shall also perform any additional services Client reasonably requests during the Term at no additional charge.
findings.explanation: This clause forces you to provide extra services requested by the client for free, leading to significant unpaid work and reduced profitability.
findings.suggested_change: Remove 'at no additional charge' and stipulate that any additional services will be subject to a written change order and billed at your standard hourly rates.

findings.quoted_text: Client may request unlimited revisions until Client is fully satisfied with each Deliverable.
findings.explanation: An unlimited revision clause allows the client to demand endless modifications without extra compensation, trapping you in an indefinite project cycle.
findings.suggested_change: Limit revisions to a specific number of rounds (e.g., two rounds per deliverable) and state that any further revisions will be billed at your standard hourly rate.

content.subject: Proposed changes to the agreement
content.body: Hello. Thank you for sharing the agreement. I am looking forward to working together and have a few minor updates to propose before signing. - Regarding the relevant clause on additional services, the current terms require extra work to be performed without compensation. I propose that we modify the agreement so that any additional services are subject to a written change order and billed at standard rates. - Regarding the relevant clause concerning revisions, the provision for unlimited modifications can create an indefinite project cycle. I propose that we limit revisions to a specific number of rounds and bill any further changes at the standard hourly rate. Thank you for your time and cooperation.
